column1: # Source surface → the rule an edit there has to keep. One source of truth, read by the
# orderloop-conventions skill and by .claude/hooks/rules-impact.sh, which says the matching rules
# once per file per session. Columns are TAB-separated:
#   2. the reminder: what the rule is and what to do, in one or two sentences
# Every row that matches a path is said, so keep rows narrow and the reminders short. The full
# reasoning behind each rule is in invariants.md.

column2: A node type needs all of: its spec here, an executor in `EXECUTORS` (apps/engine/src/nodes.ts) or an interpreter case in apps/engine/src/workflow.ts, and its icon in apps/web/app/components/node-icon.tsx. `rollback: true` needs a `ROLLBACKS` entry. Follow the add-node-type skill.

Every connector write is keyed by its step key and every compensation is idempotent; a catalog type with `rollback: true` must have a `ROLLBACKS` entry. Effects run only inside the step the Workflow opens for the node.

Determinism: every effect, clock read and model call sits inside a `step.do`; nodes are applied in graph order after each batch. Step names are `${nodeId}#${run}` and must not change for a published flow. Scheduling stays in packages/core/src/graph.ts.

Workflow → OrderAgent reports are sequenced plan snapshots (non-durable; stale ones dropped) or detail reports sent from inside steps. Keep every agent update idempotent: covered by apps/engine/tests/agent.test.ts.
Planner semantics (readiness, skips, joins, loops) live only here. Add or change a case in packages/core/tests/graph.test.ts with the `simulate` helper.
packages/core has no bindings and no Cloudflare imports (no `cloudflare:*`, no `env`, no Workers types at runtime). Anything that needs `env` belongs in an app.

`EngineRpc` is the only way the web app reaches the engine besides the proxied sockets and the forwarded /mcp, /a2a and /ucp/* routes. Change both sides together; the web app never imports engine source.
schema.ts must match packages/db/migrations/*.sql: add the next numbered migration in the same change (d1-migration skill).

A new migration must work with the code already deployed (a failed smoke test rolls the Workers back, not D1): expand now, drop or rename in a later change. Mirror it in packages/db/src/schema.ts; apps/engine/tests/migrations.test.ts runs old-shape rows through it.

Run `pnpm --filter @orderloop/<app> types`. A new resource also goes in scripts/fleet.ts (rendered per deployment) and scripts/provision.sh, then `pnpm test:fleet`. Document it in docs/configuration.md (infra-change skill).
Fleet registry and tooling: run `pnpm test:fleet`. Rings deploy staging → internal → canary → general from CI only; see docs/operations.md.
The shard hash and counts are frozen by golden tests in packages/core/tests/product-routing.test.ts. Never change what an existing key maps to; that strands every stored product.
A change to a published document's shape bumps `DOC_FORMAT` (product/paths.ts) and needs a reindex. Product types change only by a new, additive version (`typeChangeIssues`).

A catalog write lands in the shard's transaction with its outbox row and publishes from the alarm; never publish outside the outbox. A shard never awaits another shard while holding a transaction or `blockConcurrencyWhile`.

catalog-edge is read-only and serves only what the publisher wrote. At runtime it imports core only through the zod-free subpaths `@orderloop/core/product/{paths,listing,search}` (types may come from `@orderloop/core/product`; bundle ~10 KiB gzipped), and every request reaches the cached `Delivery` entrypoint by its canonical URL (routes.ts). Purges are rationed.

A UCP checkout is priced only by the checkout flow's own pricing nodes (`quoteNodes`), so the PaymentIntent held at completion is what the authorize node adopts. What it serves is tested against the vendored schemas in packages/core/tests/fixtures/ucp.

Trust-boundary code. The engine trusts a principal only when signed with `PRINCIPAL_KEY` for that path and unexpired; a UCP platform has its own envelope no other route accepts; /mcp and /a2a are separate OAuth resources. Have the security-reviewer agent look at this change before you finish.

Plugins import only @orderloop/core, @orderloop/design and @orderloop/plugin-sdk, are built with definePlugin and pass pluginContract, own their D1 and migrations, namespace node types `<id>.<name>`, and key writes by order id + step key. The core never imports plugin code and must work with no plugin bound (the engine's default test project has none).
Ledger tokens: mirror the change in packages/design/src/tokens.ts (its tests compare the two), then `pnpm sync:theme`. Never hand-edit the generated docs theme.css.
vitest stays pinned to 5.0.3: 5.0.4's module cache breaks @cloudflare/vitest-plugin. Bump it only after running the engine and catalog suites.

Pin every action by full commit SHA with its version as a comment, keep `permissions` minimal, and keep each verify step running after a failure (`if: ${{ !cancelled() }}`). Production deploys only from these workflows.
Toolkit change: run `pnpm test:toolkit`, and update .claude/README.md when you add or change an agent, skill or hook. Hook changes in settings.json take effect in a new session.
